title: AllowManifest
description: The allow manifest a compiled design system carries beside its CSS (ADR-032). Checkers read it; emitCss never does. version and contentHash identify the source document as written; specVersion names the blueprint spec. allow and library come from the resolved document when supplied.

allow.description: At most 256 catalog ids; an omitted list on an entry allows every catalog value, an empty list allows none. Keys are never __proto__, constructor or prototype.

catalogDigest.description: SHA-256 of the merged catalog the manifest was compiled against.

contentHash.description: SHA-256 of the source document as written (canonical JSON).

extensions.description: Host extension namespaces of the merged catalog, sorted; absent without extensions. At most 16.

library.description: The design system's own components as recorded on the manifest. At most 64.

specVersion.description: The blueprint spec version this manifest names (ADR-032).

version.description: The source document version as written.

allowEntry.description: The enabled values of one catalog component. An omitted list allows every catalog value; an empty list allows none. At most 32 values per axis.

libraryEntry.description: One library component recorded on the manifest: id, version and status as written.
